meta.title: Turn cost & usage overview (official prices)
meta.description: Prices every completed turn and the running session total in CNY (default; switchable to USD) at each vendor's official list prices, with an optional session budget that turns red past the cap — official CNY rows used as-is, USD-only vendors converted and flagged. The sidebar-foot Usage overview is a cross-session dashboard; the same plugin also owns the session Context tab, a right-sidebar Context panel, the /context command and its own Settings → Cost page. Surfaces use KPI tiles and cards: composition, token buckets with per-bucket money, cost breakdown, context trend (tokens / cost / cache-hit), cost by model, timing, file activity, the Agent family card (parent / self / children / grandchildren, priced from each session's own log), context events and a filterable, sortable, CSV-exportable per-request browser; the dashboard adds a 7-day tokens/cost chart, a week-aligned activity heatmap, an all-session model leaderboard and searchable session cards. Unknown models show "price unknown" instead of $0. The sidebar-foot Usage overview card also shows how much of the current subscription is left and how many days remain until the billing period ends, picking the source from the vendor of the newest request: OpenCode Go gives three usage gauges (rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly) plus a countdown, DeepSeek gives its wallet balance with the top-up and bonus split. It refreshes on press and polls every five minutes, with a matching tile at the top of the dashboard.
